tips: Prioritize 'Quranic Verse Reflections' and 'Miracles (Mu'jiza)' as these are your highest-performing themes.
Avoid generic moral preaching (e.g., 'how to control anger') and broad historical narratives, as they are significantly underperforming.
Use 'Wonder' or 'Result' hooks (e.g., 'The power of this verse...') instead of 'Instructional' hooks (e.g., 'The importance of...').
Focus on Sahaba stories that highlight specific, high-stakes virtues like Amanah (Honesty) and Tawakkul (Trust).
Target high-income demographics by emphasizing spiritual peace and divine intervention rather than basic etiquette/manners.
